candidate_parts.notes: 10 V rating covers nominal 5 V, but capacitance drops to 56.81 nF typical. Samsung 0603 metric reflow land maximum is 1.02 x 0.36 mm for the +/-0.03 mm row; add 0.25 mm per side and round. Existing 1.1 x 0.7 mm dense reservation is not qualified by this conservative method.
X5R, not X7R. C65 is on EMMC_VDDI; internal voltage and operating temperature need verification. Same 0201 land basis as CL03B104KP3NNWC. No 220 nF X7R 0201 candidate was verified.

Exact 1210 specification downloaded. Generic reflow table has a 3225 +/-0.3 mm row, with maximum copper 4.69 x 2.86 mm. Exact part length tolerance is +/-0.4 mm, so the rounded 5.5 x 3.5 mm reservation includes extra allowance and still needs exact footprint qualification.

Official typical DC-bias curve recovered. Can screen one 22 uF as a replacement for a 47 uF nominal output position, or three 22 uF for CPU/KPU. Samsung 3216 +/-0.2 mm reflow land maximum is 4.38 x 1.86 mm. Add 0.25 mm per side and round to 4.9 x 2.4 mm.
4.7 uF local decoupling candidate. Samsung 1608 +/-0.15 mm reflow land maximum is 2.41 x 1.0 mm; add 0.25 mm per side and round.

Curve-bearing 0805 input fallback. Two parts fail the assumed 8 uF input sensitivity screen; nominal capacitance and voltage rating alone are insufficient. Samsung 2012 +/-0.15 mm land maximum is 2.91 x 1.40 mm; add 0.25 mm per side and round.

TI TPS62827 table 8-2 identifies this exact 0603 part. Murata reflow ranges: a=0.7-0.9, b=0.7-0.8, c=0.8-1.0 mm; maximum copper span a+2b=2.5 mm. Add 0.25 mm per side. Z7 temperature specification is measured with 50% rated DC applied; this does not guarantee absolute capacitance at 5 V.

TI TPS62864 table 9-2 identifies this exact 0805 part. Murata reflow ranges: a=1.0-1.4, b=0.6-0.8, c=1.2-1.4 mm. Maximum copper is 3.0 x 1.4 mm; body width maximum is 1.45 mm. Add 0.25 mm per side and round. Current 2.2 x 1.3 mm reservation is narrower than the maximum body.
4.7 uF, 16 V local decoupling candidate. Same Murata 0603 reflow envelope as the 10 uF input part. Exact DC-bias curve was not recovered.

1 uF, 6.3 V X7R candidate for C815 on VDD1P8. Murata reflow ranges: a=0.3-0.5, b=0.35-0.45, c=0.4-0.6 mm; maximum copper is 1.4 x 0.6 mm. Add 0.25 mm per side. C815 ESR <0.5 ohm still needs verification at the relevant frequency.

screen_factors.explanation: Multiplying factors is a sensitivity screen, not a vendor guaranteed combined-condition lower bound. DC-bias curves are typical and use the stated AC stimulus at 25 C. The 10% aging reserve is illustrative; no lifetime or vendor aging model is established. Ambient, capacitor temperature, self-heating and model/lot uncertainty remain unresolved.

reservation_method.type: Provisional conservative planning envelope; not a PCB footprint
reservation_method.basis: Use the union of maximum manufacturer recommended reflow lands and maximum body, add 0.25 mm on each side, then round up. Samsung 1210 length tolerance is outside the generic reflow table row, so extra allowance is provisional. Manufacturer solder lands do not themselves define a courtyard.

baseline_area_summary.interpretation: Area sum is only an optimistic lower-bound screen; does NOT prove packing, escape, routing, local decoupling, thermal feasibility or assembly compatibility. DNP/test point land reservations still consume area. Unknown component choices can grow. Edge band is an explicit provisional assumption, not recovered original geometry.

coherent_review_candidate.DVFS_scope: 1.675 V is the TPS62864 maximum programmable voltage and a conservative capacitor-only screen. It is not an authorized K230 CPU/KPU voltage. The conflicting SoC DVFS limits remain unresolved.
limitations: The 10% model margin is a chosen planning allowance, not a vendor guarantee or demonstrated lot bound.
The 10% aging allowance is unqualified; lifetime, AC stimulus and temperature under bias remain unresolved.
The 3.465 V output check is an illustrative +5% voltage-margin scenario, not an established rail tolerance budget.
Memory 22 uF and local 4.7 uF candidates preserve nominal values but their required effective local decoupling and PI response are not established.
Uniform 0.25 mm clearance is a scenario assumption, not a mandatory or universal manufacturer minimum.
The scenario does not imply no smaller qualified package exists. Smaller verified Murata 0805 22 uF remains open pending its curve and qualification.
No master BOM, netlist, geometry or capacitor count changed.
The area sum is a planning sensitivity only; even a lower sum would not establish routed fit.
